entities.summary: Kent E. Hovind is an American young Earth creationist and tax protestor. His ministry focuses on denial of accepted scientific knowledge in the fields of biology, geophysics, and cosmology in favor of a literalist interpretation of the Genesis creation narrative found in the Bible. Hovind's views, which combine elements of creation science and conspiracy theory, are dismissed by the scientific community as fringe theory and pseudo-scholarship. Answers in Genesis, a fundamentalist organization advocating young Earth creationism, openly criticized him for continued use of discredited arguments abandoned by others in the movement.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Hovind's views on young Earth creationism have been widely criticized by the scientific community and have had little impact on mainstream science or society. His ministry has also been associated with tax evasion cases, which have garnered significant media attention.
